hooks.prompt: CREW HANDOFF VERIFIER: A subagent just stopped. Check its return message. If this was a crew:builder, crew:reviewer, or crew:researcher dispatched for substantial work (>5 tool calls or multi-file scope), it MUST have written a handoff artifact via write-handoff and returned the artifact path. If the return message does NOT contain a path under .claude/artifacts/crew/handoffs/, the subagent violated the handoff-before-stop contract. Action: (1) note the gap explicitly in your next message to the user, (2) run `git status` to verify working tree state, (3) check .claude/artifacts/crew/handoffs/ for recent files. Quick-lookup agents (Explore, single-grep researchers) are exempt. Do NOT silently continue past a missing handoff on substantial work.

CREW SESSION-END CHECKPOINT: Before stopping, verify these items. Skip any that don't apply.

1. UNCOMMITTED CHANGES: Run `git status --short`. If there are uncommitted changes from this session's work, either commit them or note explicitly that they are intentional WIP.

2. WORKFLOW GATES: Check if the current run has pending gates (review_required, validation_expected). If so, either resolve them or record explicit skips via mark-badge.

3. FINAL SYNTHESIS: If this was a substantial run (wrote a run-brief, dispatched subagents, produced code changes), write a final-synthesis artifact before stopping. Half-finished runs without synthesis lose context across sessions.

4. HANDOFF: If work is mid-flight and will continue in a future session, write a handoff artifact capturing scope state, what's done, what's next, and risks.

If all items are clear or not applicable, stop normally. If any item needs action, address it now.
